title: Preparer approving their own quotation — both answers of Set up Sales

steps.do: Set up Sales "Yes — when it is within their own authority". As Test BranchMgr submit their own ₹3,00,000 quotation.
steps.expect: Approved on submit — Test BranchMgr does not sign their own level (owner, 15 Nov 2026, F13). History: "Approved on submit — a self-approval: it is within Test BranchMgr's own approval authority …".
steps.observed: status PENDING_APPROVAL — Submitted for approval — 1 step(s). Now with Test BranchMgr (Branch Manager).
steps.note: Test BranchMgr cannot create a quotation (no "Create / edit quotations" right; /quote-new says: "You cannot create or edit quotations."), so "prepares" was set up as a quotation assigned to Test BranchMgr.
steps.suggest: A ₹3,00,000 quotation assigned to Test BranchMgr (made by a sales colleague).

steps.do: Test MktExec prepares a ₹3,00,000 quotation and tries to approve it.
steps.expect: No Approve button: the Level 1 step is not theirs.
steps.observed: Test MktExec made and submitted it; the Level 1 row reads "Test BranchMgr (Branch Manager) — Pending" with no Approve button for them.

steps.do: Set up Sales "No — someone else must always approve it". Repeat the first step; then try Approve as Test BranchMgr.
steps.expect: It goes to the next level up (Level 2, Test MktMgr) — level 1 is not needed. History: "Levels 1 not needed — prepared by Test BranchMgr …" and "It goes to level 2 … — someone other than the preparer must approve it." Test BranchMgr cannot approve it.
steps.observed: not passed up a level: Submitted ("Submitted for approval — 1 step(s). Now with Test BranchMgr (Branch Manager)."): levels [1]; status PENDING_APPROVAL; pressing Approve anyway: "You are not an approver for this step."; History: "".
